source_name: president.go.ke old WordPress date-path posts (Kenyatta era; Wayback/CDX)
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-26 (--spread --n 8): 4,252 date-path post captures (president.go.ke/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<slug>/, CDX prefix president.go.ke/20 ~8,000 raw). The OLD pre-Elementor WordPress site (Uhuru Kenyatta era, president 2013-2022) archives as CLEAN HTML (unlike the modern Elementor /speeches_remarks/ JS shells). TITLE(h1.entry-title) clean; TEXT via .entry-content/generic fallback (2.7k-3.9k chars); DATE from the URL permalink via url_regex ONLY (unambiguous ISO; .post-date returns a re-crawl artifact). Posts mix speeches + presidency news -> cleaner document-type gate keeps the speech/official_statement subset. NO speaker_default (Uhuru + First Lady Margaret Kenyatta + quoted ministers) -> cleaner speaker pass + tenure crosscheck. 'yes-and' to the live ken_president (Ruto 2022- PDFs): this is the Kenyatta 2013-2022 corpus. FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
